items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Yes, he did quite a few arrangements. I remember some of his arrangements were outstanding, but this guy was arranging for Earl Hines and he was - at this point - he was in the country illegally.

ctx.x: Yes, but we had no job - you see - we were just rehearsing and I got Reginald Forsythe was arranging for Hines at that time---
Did Mort Croy also do some arrangements?
Yes, he did quite a few arrangements. I remember some of his arrangements were outstanding, but this guy was arranging for Earl Hines and he was - at this point - he was in the country illegally.
